case.query: I have two separate questions: What is the single most important lifestyle change I can make to treat emphysema if I am currently a smoker? I have been diagnosed with Thoracic Outlet Syndrome. What specific sensations might I feel in my arm, hand, and fingers due to the nerve compression?
evidence: This is the most important step you can take to treat emphysema.
You may feel burning, tingling, and numbness along your arm, hand, and fingers.
